summary_p1: Software and Backend Engineer (Java, Spring Boot, Go) with a rigorous engineering foundation (Kharkiv Aerospace University, Dipl.-Ing.) and extensive experience leading commercial projects. I approach development through structural domain modeling and ERM design: aligning business requirements with a resilient, maintainable architecture that adapts swiftly to changing market needs — without drama and without rebuilding the system core.
summary_p2: I architect, build, and operate production systems end-to-end on my own bare-metal infrastructure (Proxmox, Debian 12, k3s, GitLab CI/CD). These include Numi (numi.report) — a GoBD-compliant invoicing PWA engineered with Go, SQLite WAL, and Litestream replication — and the tlab29.com platform (Java 21, Spring Boot 3.5, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes), featuring automated disaster recovery restoration drills and offsite cloud backup replication.
summary_quip: // Guiding principles: Architecture before code; data security before deployment; client value before developer convenience.
